source_policy: 保刀霸气追加对方防御20%、剑无坚减防50%、两护身对怪50%/对角色基础防御+50%、医每点总攻击0.5%、格斗暴击减10%。概率/时序/作用锚及其余系数为项目值；谭护身冲突已在学习合同具体采用，不无视秘籍条件。

bindings.name: 无坚不摧
bindings.eligible_root_override: attack_martial_skill only; explicit63794八转published restriction, not basicnormal

chance_policy: requires learned allocated positive effective grade; chance=100*grade bp with max4000 for explicitly probabilistic profiles below; stable root/primary/unique target hit receipt, derived events never recursively proc

defense_based_extra.input: target ordinary defense anchor at hit before this attack penetration, noPvEdefense
defense_based_extra.pipeline: one tagged armor_penalty_extra after ordinary defense/flat reduction on successful root primary hit, before percent protection; no second hit/crit/ordinary mitigation or extra callbacks

defense_based_extra_hero.scope: Han-qualified identity, not borrowed ordinary blade passive

half_ordinary_defense.target: original primary, first valid direct hit once per action
half_ordinary_defense.scope: ordinary defense source final subtotal; PvE guard ratings separate; not remove maxHP/skill/equipment identity
half_ordinary_defense.stacking: same-family strongest only, separate source remaining times, same-source refresh180notadd
half_ordinary_defense.future_hits: use temporarily reduced live ordinary defense, no rewriting persistent base

monster_half_damage_or_martial_defense.chance: chance_policy, defensive per unique direct hit before ordinary defense calculation
monster_half_damage_or_martial_defense.incoming_kind: explicit hostile monster vs martialNPC; playerPvPstilldisabled
monster_half_damage_or_martial_defense.monster: current received hit damage multiply5000bp in protection stage, no additional persistent defense
monster_half_damage_or_martial_defense.martial_npc: current hit ordinary defense anchor multiplied15000bp before defense formula, no additional50percent damage reduction

attack_to_defense.ordinary_attack_sum_anchor: sum lower+upper final attack before any defense-to-attack feedback, PvE-only attack or final override; dependency cycle is configuration error
attack_to_defense.base_rule_origin: 0.5percent per point original; sum of interval endpoints is explicit project interpretation not proven official meaning

martial_flat_protection.scope: flat damage reduction only on direct attack_martial_skill after normal defense, not ordinary defense stat or percent

critical_protection.eligible: actually committed root critical or explicit lethal-strike-tagged direct hit
critical_protection.source_difference: 10percent original preserved; grade-scaled qualification is project probability, never blanket ordinary-attack reduction
critical_protection.combines: if hit both critical and lethal, one roll/10percent once; other declared protection sources each once, no extra event

protection_order: pre-defense defensive-proc slot: sword/tan护身 choose one target-kind branch; build ordinary defense (including physician converted term), apply existing half-defense source, optional martialNPC guard50percent then formula23. Post-defense fixed protection includes fighter flat; armor extra once; percent protections by stable family ID (gasTan,critical,monster护身,otherexplicit) then Zhen shield/Mei barrier. Check all intermediate exact ranges.
feedback_policy: derived physician defense cannot feed an attack-to-defense-to-attack cycle; reject SCC before configuration activation, not iterate until stable or fallback0. Half-defense live reduction never re-grants equipment/point budget or changes slot ownership.
persistence: continuous contributions recomputed, timed half-defense sources saved remaining steps, per-hit defensive/critical draws and armor extra receipt captured. Class-qualified passive IDs prevent same name merging; save/replay never doubles reduction or derived add.

persistent_half_defense_state.legacy_import: 四已知旧来源显式空表；现行缺字段拒绝，不用当前防御一半反推来源。
persistent_half_defense_state.fields: 固定无坚不摧qigong_sword_0eb0bff69140，仅source_actor_id/trigger_event_id/reduction_bp/remaining_steps1..180；trigger为原剑客攻击武功首合格主目标命中后真实成功落效结果。reduction_bp为原已接纳动作冻结的5000基础或乘胜增强后的5000+50*有效乘胜等级，最高7000；该动作接纳时原乘胜必须存活且来源合格，否则5000。原结果保乘胜来源及等级证据，不从落效时后来当前buff倒算；普通攻击/衍生攻击不合格。
persistent_half_defense_state.identity: 每施放者最多一源，按source_actor_id排序；新成功落效替换同源凭证/原实际减防比例/180，不叠加；重放不刷新。多源独立计时，普通防御只用最高reduction_bp一次，同值按trigger_event_id/source_actor_id稳定选唯一源，不累乘。
persistent_half_defense_state.timing: 原触发命中的防御已用旧状态完成，本次新源只影响后续命中；生成步不扣新180，后续世界步入口扣旧源，0先移再新伤害；暂停离线冻结。固定180，不套未明确采用的时长修正。
persistent_half_defense_state.derivation: 对当前普通防御小计按原23与protection_order乘(10000-最强实际reduction_bp)/10000向下取整一次；基础50%，乘胜最高70%。不削怪物防护评级、不改装备/预算/最大HP，不保存减防后的面板副本。负防御/非法锚沿原配置校验拒绝，不读档改写基表。
persistent_half_defense_state.lifecycle: 接收者死亡或原合法解除清对应源；施放者离线/死亡不补时或取消已付效果，0余时不保存。原触发/职业/同源唯一和逐步余时仍语义门槛，待复活必须空表。
persistent_half_defense_state.world_entity_field: 本明确采用的世界怪物actor.effects.half_ordinary_defense，受体限制/根与生命周期沿普通怪效果根.v1.json；同族原来源结构只存目标实体一次。
